subject: CYCLE-1 FINDING: ticket 05 refresh-lease implementation/runtime proof not evidenced at current main
body: At GitHub main 7127c287a17fd97050c98fbeb05a38f7318f2f64, targeted repository searches found no app/source hits for REFRESH_LEASE_ACQUIRE, preferredRefreshRate, setFrameRate, refreshRate, preferredDisplayModeId, 120Hz, or Choreographer. MainActivity only boots overlay permission/service flow and contains no refresh-control logic. Recursive tree search for '120' resolves to contracts/evidence/service-pack material rather than an app refresh implementation. This is evidence of an implementation/proof gap, not an absolute claim that no indirect platform behavior can occur. Existing Gen7 regression baseline independently classifies the 120Hz invariant as mandatory but unproven by beta2-specific tests. Physical Fold7 delivered-cadence proof remains NOT_RUN/FIELD_BLOCKED.
